extDesc.message: Bilingual web translation with your own model. Full page, hover, selection and input box; works with any OpenAI-compatible API.

urlHintBase.message: Up to the version part, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1; local servers like http://localhost:1234/v1

urlHintAnthropic.message: Defaults to https://api.anthropic.com — usually nothing to change

urlHintGemini.message: Defaults to https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com — usually nothing to change

urlHintOllama.message: Defaults to http://localhost:11434; run ollama serve and pull a model first

urlHintCustom.message: The full request URL. Headers, body and response path can be customised under Advanced

targetLangHint.message: Pages will be translated into this language

autoTranslateNote.message: (pages already in the target language are skipped)

hoverTranslate.message: Translate a single paragraph on hover

inputTranslate.message: Input-box translation (press space 3 times to translate what you typed)

serviceHint.message: Save several service profiles and switch between them freely. Local models (Ollama, LM Studio…) work without an API key.

providerNameHint.message: Shown in the dropdown. Anything you like

fieldModelHint.message: e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.0-flash, qwen2.5:7b

fieldTemperatureHint.message: 0 is recommended for translation; lower is more stable

fieldSystemPromptHint.message: {{target}} is replaced with the target language name. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt

promptSystem.message: You are a professional translation engine. Translate the user's text into {{target}}. Output only the translation — no explanations, no quotation marks. Keep HTML tags and placeholders unchanged.

promptContextRule.message: The input is a JSON array of consecutive paragraphs from one document. Reply with a JSON array of the same length, one translation per item. Use the surrounding context: keep terminology, grammatical person and tone consistent throughout, and resolve ambiguity (pronouns, polysemy, elliptical sentences) accordingly. Output nothing else.

promptExpert.message: You are an expert translator in the field of {0}; use that field's professional terminology.

promptGlossary.message:
You must follow this glossary (the left side is always translated as the right side):
{0}

promptTitle.message: The document is titled "{0}". Use it only to understand the domain and context; do not translate it.

promptContext.message:
Here are the paragraphs surrounding the text to translate. Use them only as context; do not translate them:
{0}

fieldGlossaryHint.message: One entry per line as source=target. Matching terms are forced to the given translation

fieldGlossaryPlaceholder.message:
neural network=神经网络
prompt=提示词

advSummary.message: Advanced: change these when the response can't be parsed, or for a non-standard API

advMethodHint.message: Usually POST; with GET no request body is sent

advUrlTemplateHint.message: {{url}} is the address you entered above

advHeadersHint.message: One per line as Key: Value

advBodyHint.message: Placeholders are inserted as JSON values — no need to add quotes

advResponsePathHint.message: e.g. choices[0].message.content; leave empty if the whole response is the translation

advVarsHint.message: Available in the request body: {{url}} {{apiKey}} {{model}} {{temperature}} {{target}} {{source}} {{system}} {{texts}} (JSON array string) {{textsJson}} (real array) {{text}} (plain text)

subtitleHint.message: Shows bilingual subtitles whenever the video already has them — it never turns subtitles on by itself. Works with standard WebVTT tracks and YouTube's own captions.

sitesHint.message: Right-click on a page, or use the popup, to set “always translate” or “never translate” for a site.

createdProvider.message: Created “{0}” — don't forget to fill in the API key

confirmReset.message: Reset everything to defaults? Your service profiles and site rules will be lost.

shortcutPageHint.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions change their own shortcuts; this opens the browser's shortcut page.

shortcutConflictHint.message: If a shortcut clashes with the browser or another extension, Chrome silently ignores it — pick another combination.

cacheHint.message: The cache lives in memory only and is cleared when the browser restarts.

pdfLimitHint.message: Text-layer PDFs only — scanned images contain no text to read.

pdfNoText.message: No extractable text in this PDF (it may be a scan).

exportEmpty.message: Nothing to export yet — translate the page first

popUnsupported.message: This page can't be translated (browser-internal or store page)

popNeedKey.message: This service needs an API key — add it in More settings

welLead.message: Turn any page into a bilingual read — with the model you choose.

welStep1.message: Open any page in another language

welStep1Note.message: A floating button appears in the bottom-right corner

welStep2Note.message: Translations are inserted under each original paragraph

welStep3Note.message: Google Translate works out of the box; swap in any model whenever you like

welMoreTitle.message: Three more ways to use it

welCardHoverNote.message: Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> and rest the cursor on a paragraph to translate just that one.

welCardSelectionNote.message: Select any text to get a popup with the translation, ready to copy.

welCardInputNote.message: Press <kbd>space</kbd> 3 times in any input to translate what you are writing.

welMoreHint.message: Toggles and shortcuts live in Settings. <kbd>Alt+W</kbd> switches between bilingual and translation-only.

welPrivacyNote.message: Settings and the translation cache stay on this computer. When translating, page text goes straight to the endpoint you configured — Shuangyi has no server and collects nothing.

welFooter.message: You can always come back via the extension icon → gear

csNoParagraphs.message: No translatable paragraphs found on this page

csRetranslate.message: Translate this paragraph again (with surrounding context)

csCopyFailed.message: Copy failed — the browser blocked clipboard access

csBallFailedTitle.message: {0} paragraphs failed — click to retry the page

errDeeplNoKey.message: No DeepL API key configured — add one in Settings

errNoTranslation.message: “{0}” produced no translation: response path “{1}” matched nothing. Response snippet: {2}

errCannotConnect.message: Can't reach the service — the URL is wrong, or the service isn't running
